about.label: About
about.paragraph1: Mechatronics engineer specialized in industrial automation, robotic control and hardware-software integration. Skilled at designing and implementing real-time control architectures and robotic gait analysis, using low-level C/C++ firmware optimized through direct port registers on microcontrollers and IMU-based stability metrics.
about.paragraph2: Strong ability to bridge the physical control of mechatronic systems with modern software architectures, spanning simulation environments and robotic operating systems (ROS 2) through to TypeScript backend infrastructure and containerized deployments with Docker. Known for a rigorous approach to data modeling, network analysis and automated testing to keep automation systems highly reliable, accurate and scalable.
about.quote: Robotics and automation are the pinnacle of industrial processes.
